objective: Make parallel AI build coordination genuinely shared across separate Git worktrees so 2-3 concurrent mutating sessions see the same leases and integration lock, without changing heartbeat, browser extension, or bridge transport behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Two real Git worktrees of the same repository resolve to one shared coordination runtime.
Non-overlapping path claims from distinct worktrees are allowed concurrently.
Overlapping path claims across distinct worktrees are blocked fail-closed.
The integration lock is exclusive across distinct worktrees.
Canonical governance points mutating sessions to the shared coordinator entrypoint.
No heartbeat files, browser extension files, or bridge transport files are changed.
non_goals: No browser extension or bridge transport changes.
No live trading, wallet, paid API or credential actions.
No force push or history rewrite.
independent_verification: Focused tests create multiple real Git worktrees and prove shared registry/conflict/integration-lock behavior.
rollback_plan: Revert E002 commits and continue using the prior coordinator while parallel mutating sessions remain disabled.
cleanup_plan: Test worktrees are temporary pytest resources; runtime coordination state lives under Git common-dir and leases expire by TTL.
